column1: Jack-8 specializes in poking and rushdown using his powerful lows such as "db+1" and "hFC.db+1" to chip away at opponents. He has strong approach tools, including his long-reaching "2"  jab, while his threatening FC mix and Gamma Howl (GMH) stance give him multiple ways to maintain pressure once he's in. He also has an above average backdash and a full throw game ("qcb+2", "qcf+1", "uf+1+2").
Jack-8 has a straightforward game plan

Jack-8 gains access to "H.f+3+4" and "H.uf+3", which are enhanced versions of the original moves. He also gains access to his Gamma Charge moves  ("GMC.1", "GMC.2", "GMC.3+4").
Jack-8 can also gain a stack of Gamma Charge by doing a charge move such as "b+2*", "f,f+2*" etc, giving him access to perform one Gamma Charge move.

On wall-break stages, "GMC.2" is threatening, as Jack-8 can follow up with his heatsmash afterwards to break the wall for a combo. Jack-8's red bubble "GMC.3+4" is a strong general option due to being a homing powercrush that heals even with no grey health and does chip to the opponent. Otherwise, it is important to utilize "b+1+2" as it is a high-coverage heat dash option with its tracking and speed, and Jack-8's heat smash as a punish or frametrap.
